label: D1 reward shown, agent about to choose a2, early in the episode
explanation: Fires only at D1 and only when the reward input is 1 (100% of mass; never at GO or D2, never after no reward). Within rewarded D1 steps it is strongly selective for the agent going to choose a2 (96% of mass; the reward usually came from S2 too) and for the first part of the episode: the rate falls from about 10% in trials 0-19 to 0 after trial 70. The predicate uses action, the agent own upcoming choice at D1, which counts as FUTURE but is something the agent computes; the observed-only version (choice logit < 0 instead of action == 2) scores a bit lower (dev F1 0.55 vs 0.62). Magnitude is largest on the first reward after unrewarded trials and decays over a run of consecutive rewards (reward onset after a non-reward holds 49% of mass on 35% of active steps). It is silent on most rewarded a2 D1 steps late in long reward streaks, which is the main source of false positives. Precision is about 0.48, so this is a partial explanation.
